terrainNote: 360×180 geographic raster sampled from the actual authored physical terrain; coast fractions and heights are approximate, no artistic height exaggeration.

native.notes: Current production physics, January reinitialization, first transient year, monthly means weighted by physical seconds. Air is the current single-column variable; wind is the current single-layer wind.

initialization.seaTemperatureInput: native cold start, no SST input; native mixed-layer initialization 271.25 K
initialization.validation: First-step diagnostics, not a climate-accuracy check

gcm.notes: Every physical step sampled; exact Gregorian non-leap calendar counts; first transient year, no spin-up. 2m air temperature, lowest sigma-layer wind, total precipitation. Area-conservative remapping to the display grid.
